id./param/scenario/cs/a_100_cs_020.pack|cs_: "We're finally here! Octagonia, the town where tough guys gather!
"Tch! They treat Hendrik as a hero here too. It really makes my blood boil.
"Hi there, handsome gentlemen. Would you be interested in a fighting tournament?
"Soon we're holding an amazing event called the Masked Tourney. If you're confident in your strength, come join in!
"Let's see... "Announcing the blood-pumping Masked Tourney tag match. The champions win fabulous prizes!" Hmm...
"I thought it was the dancing kind of masquerade ball, but it's the fighting kind. But what does "masked" mean?
"It says it'll be held in the coliseum on the rooftop... Is that at the top of that building?
